notes: Schematic graph-distance layout with monotone population magnification for readable basins. Water means no graph connection. Island spacing is arbitrary. Contours interpolate original-space density ranks; ochre indicates high original local-dimension rank. Fog denotes median neighbor Jaccard below 0.45 under 0.01-chord perturbation. Roads simplify real graph paths; unshown edges still exist.

route_ambiguity.meaning: Median entropy-equivalent count of enumerated near-shortest regional routes to up to three reference destinations. Not entropy over all paths or semantic prediction difficulty.

meanings.name: Flat plain
meanings.visual: Low relief with aligned short neighbor links; repeated coordinates overlap.
meanings.inference: Many nearby replacements; relatively few local directions.
meanings.limit: Density alone is insufficient; near-substitutes use an explicit distance tolerance.

meanings.name: Mountain
meanings.measure: High local dimension or strong metric variation
meanings.visual: Measured relief and local direction spectrum; spread across many PCA axes.
meanings.inference: A two-axis map omits much of the neighborhood geometry.
meanings.limit: Height is complexity, not value or automatically expensive travel.

meanings.name: Cliff
meanings.measure: An unusually long crossing relative to its local spacing
meanings.visual: A break across a gap and a long, costly crossing; gap ratio is labelled.
meanings.inference: Nearby-looking locations may require a large original-space step.
meanings.limit: A cliff may still have a usable bridge; a low-dimensional region can have a cliff.

meanings.name: Narrow pass
meanings.visual: Many approach links compress into a small crossing, then fan out.
meanings.inference: Few alternative regional crossings; closure can disconnect regions.
meanings.limit: The displayed critical pass is a stricter subset of low-conductance passages.

meanings.name: Maze
meanings.measure: Entropy of enumerated near-shortest routes to an explicit target
meanings.visual: Actual alternative routes split, weave and rejoin.
meanings.inference: Many similarly priced routes remain plausible.
meanings.limit: Bounded regional route-set entropy, not all-path entropy; ambiguity is not necessarily failure or difficulty.

meanings.name: Isolated island
meanings.measure: Disconnected component or weak cross-scale attachment
meanings.visual: Separate shorelines; weak connections are dashed and identified separately.
meanings.inference: No retained route, or only condition-sensitive attachment.
meanings.limit: Water represents this graph and threshold, not absolute separation in the full space.

meanings.name: Ridge / boundary
meanings.measure: Low cross-neighborhood conductance across scales, crossing-distance contrast and a local density dip
meanings.visual: A continuous seam with visible crossing gates and scale evidence.
meanings.inference: Separation persists under the analyzed graph scales.
meanings.limit: Reference navigation cells define the cut; this is not proof of semantic or independently discovered cluster boundaries.

meanings.name: Fog / unstable ground
meanings.measure: Neighborhood changes under reference resampling or dimensional compression
meanings.visual: A disagreement field and original/changed neighbor-link ghosts.
meanings.inference: The apparent neighborhood depends on the observation condition.
meanings.limit: Compression sensitivity can be structure or noise; resampling has unavoidable missing-item loss.

mesh.meaning: Color is covariance variance omitted by two axes. Local meshes are actual PCA-3 envelopes; spectra expose further hidden directions. Covariance participation ratio differs from radius-growth dimension.

fields.name: Variation hidden by two axes
fields.description: Fraction of original-neighborhood covariance outside its first two axes. Teal retains most variation; purple hides much more.

fields.name: Effective local directions
fields.description: Covariance participation ratio. Contours labelled 2, 4 or 8 enclose those measured direction counts; it is not an integer rank.

fields.name: Original-space density rank
fields.description: Inverse neighbor-radius percentile in the original space. This is independent of how crowded the display looks.

fields.name: Near-substitute fraction
fields.description: Share of signature neighbors within the declared chord tolerance. A dense plain also needs low dimension and redundancy.

fields.name: Regional route alternatives
fields.description: Median effective count of up to 12 near-shortest regional routes to reference destinations. Bundles identify their actual destination.

fields.name: Reference-subset disagreement
fields.description: One minus conditional neighbor overlap under reference resampling. Missing references are handled by the backend comparison.

fields.name: Compression disagreement
fields.description: One minus neighbor overlap under the recorded moderate PCA compression. It can reflect discarded structure or noise.

fields.name: Metric-variation rank
fields.description: Percentile of local neighbor-distance coefficient of variation. This is a separate measure from dimension.

fields.name: Combined geometry disagreement
fields.description: Maximum reference-subset and moderate-compression disagreement. Hatching can display it independently of the color field.

flat.note: Color and contour channels are independent. All positions remain strictly 2D; masked fields and contours never join disconnected component charts.
